shared_mechanics.permission: Exact face-up exile ObjectRef plus actor and inclusive current-turn expiry. New life-only rows grant ordinary land plays but do not enable ordinary paid spell casting; independent other permissions remain usable. Successful actual Exile arrivals only. Finite top-library bound retains full X scalar until bounded by library length.
shared_mechanics.alternative: Explicit cast method/face with zero base mana cost, X in mana cost fixed to0, life equal to chosen stack face mana value. Life is mandatory, not an optional alternate route; mandatory and optional additional costs and normal timing remain. Existing borrowed funding/ordered cost context checks all costs including exact-equality life payments. New AlternativeLife clause keeps replacement mana-cost life independent of identical-valued additional-X Life clauses. Zero life cost performs actual cost declaration/payment without losing life.
shared_mechanics.route_isolation: One helper configures BOTH borrowed cast preview and actual announcement: resets permission-specific spend-any-mana, exile-on-graveyard and foreign-stash flags inherited by the ordinary cast constructor. Other ordinary permission routes retain those effects and remain usable.
shared_mechanics.ownership: Existing owned permission vector, cast transaction and rollback checkpoint retain new state with existing size-based accounting. New announcement action included in rollback capture; actual foreign entry failure restores paid life, exact exile generation/permission and selectively retained/reversed mana event. No new private continuation or shared mutable rules state.

printed_assertion_map.You may play those cards this turn: Actual land owner/controller, main-phase timing, ordinary land allowance, expiry at cleanup, source already gone to graveyard. Actual creature/spell cast by caster, original owner excluded, new exile incarnation cannot reuse old permission; independent normal/Adventure permissions remain available.
printed_assertion_map.If you cast this way, pay life equal to: Actual lost life and LifeLost observer milling; insufficient/equal/zero CR118.4 boundaries; Adventure chosen face value3 vs physical2, foreign mana-X forced0, additional-X life remains separate. Casting countered spells does not refund life.
printed_assertion_map.Normal timing and additional costs: Actual Stir Up Trouble sacrifice OR additional4mana, Harbinger extra flash mana, optional kicker with live Radagast cost reduction affects mana only, original mana value life unchanged. Independent permissions have isolated conditional modifiers.
printed_assertion_map.Legality/privacy/transaction/owned roots: Illegal proposals and targets preserve snapshots/revisions; both player observations protect hidden cards. Representative raw/index/restore and parent-drop children at life cost choice; actual foreign aura entry strands casualty and rolls back paid life with green mana selectively retained/reversed.

fixture_policy: Explicit19-name whitelist; every name paired and admitted before queue, unknown/incomplete names fail assertions. Exploratory preflight failed for unavailable proposed names rather than silently skipping them; only verified final fixtures enter tests.
limitations: No admitted global static spell-tax fixture or typed spell-cost-increase descriptor exists in this base; parent explicitly approved recording this rather than inventing unrelated mechanics. Actual supported surcharge, mandatory additional mana, nonmana additional costs, optional kicker and live reduction are proved.

Focused author proof is not full release or full HOB set acceptance. Parent owns regenerated artifacts, final integrated release and two independent nonauthor reviews. No simulation throughput extrapolation.
